confirmed.title: Boot wizard's worker QThreads are parented to a QDialog that run_boot_flow_gate drops on return → 0xC0000409 abort whenever the gate exits with a worker still running (X/Esc during provider check, #640 deadline, Ctrl+C)
confirmed.scenario: User launches the cockpit, sees 'กำลังตรวจสอบอัพเดต provider…' and clicks the X (or presses Esc): closeEvent/reject only guard PAGE_MIGRATING (lines 2236, 2249), so done() emits flowFinished(True), loop.exec() returns, MainWindow is built (2412) and the local `wizard` is garbage-collected while `_CallWorker` (check_provider_updates: up to 5 `--version` + 3 `npm view`, 15/30 s caps) is still running → Qt qFatal 'QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running' → process dies right after the main window appears. Same abort for the #640 deadline (2362-2379): it fires on ANY page, including page C mid-migration (footer itself says 2–5 min vs 180 s default), builds MainWindow while `_MigrationWorker` is still copying (panes then write into RUNTIME_DIR mid-ladder) and aborts at frame exit. Same for Ctrl+C via _poll_quit → sys.exit(0) unwinding the frame. tests/test_boot_flow_window.py:1565 stubs start() so no worker ever exists — the 'wedged stage still opens the cockpit' test never exercises a live worker.
confirmed.evidence: Workers parented to the dialog: line 2148 `worker = _CallWorker(lambda: flow.check_provider_updates(30.0), self)`, 2162, 2207, 2215, and 1540 `worker = _MigrationWorker(self._flow, signals, self)`; gate holds no ref after `return main_window_factory()` (2412). Reproduced with this venv's PyQt6: a Python-owned QObject parent with a running child QThread dropped at function return → exit code -1073740791 (0xC0000409) before the next print. events.log on prod confirms boots go through the wizard (`"phase": "gate_start", "wizard": true`).
confirmed.fix: Keep the wizard alive past the gate (module-level ref or parent it to the QApplication) and `wait()`/`quit()` every entry in `_workers` before returning; give workers no parent (hold them in `_workers`) so dialog teardown can't delete them; never fire the deadline while `_stack.currentIndex() == PAGE_MIGRATING` (re-arm it on each progress event instead); on _poll_quit, stop workers before sys.exit.

confirmed.title: load_projects() fail-open to an empty registry is persisted by the next writer (set_open_tabs/clear_active_project) → every project wiped from the V2 registry
confirmed.scenario: Post-#504 the V1 projects.json is archived, so the V2 registry is the only copy. If one read of registry.json fails transiently (OSError/PermissionError from an AV/backup tool holding the file, or a UnicodeDecodeError), load_projects logs a warning and returns `empty` ({"active": None, "projects": {}}). The user then closes/opens/reorders a tab → main_window.py:1358 set_open_tabs → `data = load_projects()` (empty) → known=set() → cleaned=[] → save_projects_json writes `registry["data"] = {"active": None, "projects": {}, "open_tabs": []}` over the real registry. Next boot: zero projects, no V1 fallback. clear_active_project (config.py:834-836) has the same shape. Rare trigger, unrecoverable outcome.
confirmed.evidence: config.py:642-644 `except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:` / `_log.warning(...)` / `return empty`; config.py:862-874 `data = load_projects()` … `data["open_tabs"] = cleaned` / `save_projects_json(data)`; config.py:666-667 `registry["data"] = data` / `return _write_json_atomic(registry_path, registry)`

Reproduced with venv python + temp file: load → save {a,b} → load returns ['a'] only; delete_role('b') returns True while b stays on disk; correct after 3.1s. (3) cleanup.role_delete_plan:76 shows 'Built-in role ลบไม่ได้' for a role created <3s ago. (4) two saves <3s apart (create A then create/update B) → A's registry entry dropped.

confirmed.title: UTF-8 BOM file gains one extra BOM on every Ctrl+S (data corruption)
confirmed.scenario: Open any BOM-prefixed file (PowerShell .ps1, .csproj, files saved by Notepad/VS on Windows) in the Monaco editor and press Ctrl+S. The file on disk now starts with EF BB BF EF BB BF; each further save appends another BOM and Monaco shows a growing run of invisible U+FEFF chars at line 1.
confirmed.evidence: editor_widget.py:153 `text = resolved.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` (codec keeps U+FEFF; only utf-8-sig strips it) -> static/editor/index.html:512 `monaco.editor.createModel(text, ...)` / :322 `tab.model.getValue()` round-trips it -> editor_service.py:181-183 `data = text.encode("utf-8")` then `if expected.bom: data = _UTF8_BOM + data` prepends a second BOM.
confirmed.fix: In read_file_for_editor use `encoding="utf-8-sig"` (or `text.lstrip("﻿")`), and in editor_service._encode_for_write strip a leading U+FEFF from `text` before prepending _UTF8_BOM.

tracer.reasoning: CONFIRMED by code trace and live probe with the repo venv. src/agent_takkub/editor_widget.py:153 reads with encoding="utf-8" (keeps U+FEFF in text); src/agent_takkub/editor_service.py:131 records bom=True in EditorFileState; on save, editor_service.py:181-183 encodes the FEFF-bearing text back to bytes (EF BB BF) and then prepends _UTF8_BOM again because expected.bom is True. Probe: read_file_for_editor + save_atomic on a BOM .ps1 produced head bytes efbbbfefbbbf after one open+save, and efbbbfefbbbfefbbbf after a second open+save cycle — one extra BOM per open->save cycle (the finding's 'every Ctrl+S' is slightly imprecise: repeated saves within one open session hold at +1 BOM since the model still contains a single U+FEFF, but each reopen+save adds another). Entry point is real day-to-day use: Explorer double-click / CHANGES row -> EditorHost.open_file -> Monaco -> Ctrl+S -> bridge.saveFile -> save_atomic. Not fixed in v2.1.32: #702-#710 batch did not touch editor code; no utf-8-sig/FEFF strip exists in editor_widget.py or editor_service.py. Severity high: silent, unbounded corruption of any BOM-prefixed file (PowerShell .ps1, .csproj, Notepad/VS-saved files — ubiquitous on Windows); double BOM breaks tools that only strip one BOM (e.g. utf-8-sig readers, JSON parsers) and accumulates invisible U+FEFF runs at line 1. Fix as proposed: read with utf-8-sig at editor_widget.py:153 and/or lstrip('﻿') in _encode_for_write before prepending.
tracer.repro: 1) On Windows, create a BOM file: powershell `Set-Content -Path t.ps1 -Value 'Write-Host hi' -Encoding UTF8BOM` (head bytes EF BB BF). 2) Launch the cockpit, open the project, double-click t.ps1 in the workspace Explorer to open it in the Monaco editor. 3) Press Ctrl+S without editing. 4) Hex-dump the file: `Format-Hex t.ps1 | Select -First 1` — it now starts EF BB BF EF BB BF. 5) Close and reopen the tab, Ctrl+S again — three BOMs; Monaco shows a growing run of invisible U+FEFF at line 1.

skeptic.reasoning: Confirmed in v2.1.32 code and by live repro with the project venv. src/agent_takkub/editor_widget.py:153 `text = resolved.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` keeps the leading U+FEFF (only utf-8-sig strips it), while editor_service.stat_snapshot:131 records `bom=True` for the same file. The text is sent to Monaco unmodified (editor_widget.py:685 editorOpenFile) and comes back unmodified via saveFile; save_atomic → _encode_for_write (editor_service.py:181-183) does `data = text.encode("utf-8")` then `if expected.bom: data = _UTF8_BOM + data`, prepending a second BOM on top of the FEFF already inside `text`. No stripping exists anywhere: grep for feff/bom in editor_widget.py and static/editor/index.html finds none. Test coverage misses it: tests/test_editor_service.py:389 test_preserves_bom_on_save passes replacement text WITHOUT a leading FEFF, so it never exercises the real read→save round-trip. Repro (venv python, scratchpad temp file): file b"\xef\xbb\xbfWrite-Host hi\r\n" → read_file_for_editor → save_atomic(res.text, res.state) → bytes start EF BB BF EF BB BF; after one reopen+save, three BOMs. One correction to the claim's wording: within a single open session repeated Ctrl+S stays at 2 BOMs (Monaco text is unchanged); growth is one BOM per open+save cycle. Reachable in real use: any BOM-prefixed file (.ps1, .csproj, Notepad/VS-saved files — common on this Windows-first product) opened in the workspace editor and saved. Severity high: silent cumulative corruption of user source files; the second/third BOM is in-content U+FEFF which makes Python source a SyntaxError and breaks strict JSON parsers.
skeptic.repro: Open any UTF-8-BOM file in the cockpit editor and Ctrl+S; or run with .venv python: read_file_for_editor(f,[root]) on a file starting with EF BB BF, then save_atomic(f, result.text, result.state, [root]) → f.read_bytes() starts with EF BB BF EF BB BF.

confirmed.title: Re-opening an already-open file silently discards unsaved edits
confirmed.scenario: User edits a file in the editor (dirty), then double-clicks the same file in the Explorer or clicks its row in the CHANGES panel (main_window.py:542 -> open_file(show_diff=True)). confirmed.evidence: editor_widget.py:628-644 open_file never checks `abs_path in self._open_paths`; static/editor/index.html:519-524 `} else { tab.text = text; // reopen with fresh content\n tab.dirty = false; ... tab.model.setValue(text); }`
confirmed.fix: In open_file, if the resolved path is already in _open_paths: skip the worker, run_js to activate the tab (and dispatch _on_diff_requested when show_diff) instead of editorOpenFile; alternatively make JS editorOpenFile refuse setValue when tab.dirty.

confirmed.title: Feedback-prompt auto-skip in _send_when_ready._check has no cooldown/attempt cap → '0\r' written every 150 ms poll; delivery stays prompt-blocked
confirmed.scenario: A gemini/agy teammate shows the CLI survey ('How's the CLI experience so far? … [0] Skip') while a task is being delivered. `_prompt_block_reason` (line 223-227) calls `is_at_feedback_prompt()` with NO provider → generic regex over the FULL screen (pty_session.py:2805,2818). `_check` runs every 150 ms and writes the skip key unconditionally each poll while the survey text is still on screen; each extra '0\r' after the prompt closes is submitted to the composer as a user message '0'. Meanwhile `_reason` stays truthy → `can_accept_input(prompt_blocked=True)` keeps ready_streak at 0; at timeout `_deliver(unconfirmed=True)` sees reason 'feedback' → 30 s defer → `_warn_lead_delivery_blocked_ceiling` → task never pasted. The two other auto-skip sites gate on `feedback_prompt_dismiss_ts` (3 s cooldown, max 3 attempts: orchestrator.py:13583-13586, spawn_engine.py:4460) — this one does not.
confirmed.evidence: lead_inbox.py:1761 `if _reason == "feedback":` … 1770-1771 `_skip_key = feedback_prompt_skip_key_for(_prov) or "0\r"` / `pane.session.write(_skip_key)` (no latch, no PaneState cooldown); pty_session.py:2805 `text = "\n".join(self.display_lines()).lower()`
confirmed.fix: Reuse PaneState.feedback_prompt_dismiss_ts/attempts here (skip if now-ts<3.0 or attempts>=3), and do not count 'feedback' as prompt_blocked once a skip has been sent within the last few seconds. Also add 'feedback' to the kind map at lines 2614-2618.

tracer.repro: 1) Cockpit with a gemini/agy teammate pane whose CLI shows its periodic survey ("How's the CLI experience so far? ... [0] Skip", field-confirmed #509) — or any pane whose visible screen matches both generic regexes (pty_session.py:327-334), since _prompt_block_reason passes no provider. 2) While the survey is on screen, Lead runs `takkub assign --role <role> "<task>"` (any _send_when_ready delivery also triggers it: stuck-recover, auto-respawn, park resume). 3) Watch runtime/events.log: `feedback_prompt_auto_skipped ... at=delivery` repeats every ~150 ms with no cooldown, and the pane receives repeated '0\r' writes — each write after the prompt closes submits a stray "0" user message. 4) If the survey text remains in the visible screen after dismissal, `task_deliver_blocked_on_prompt reason=feedback` then `task_deliver_prompt_defer_ceiling reason=feedback` fire and the task is never pasted (delivery-blocked-ceiling notice to Lead labels it the fallback "interactive shell prompt" because the kind map at lead_inbox.py:2614-2618 has no "feedback" entry).
tracer.reasoning: Confirmed, not refuted, still present in v2.1.32 (commit 8cdad961 touched lead_inbox.py only near line 345 and 1042). src/agent_takkub/lead_inbox.py:1761-1771: inside _send_when_ready's _check poll (QTimer, _READY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=150, line 164), `if _reason == "feedback": ... pane.session.write(_skip_key)` runs unconditionally every poll — it neither reads nor sets PaneState.feedback_prompt_dismiss_ts/feedback_prompt_dismiss_attempts, unlike the two sibling auto-skip sites (orchestrator.py:13583-13593: 3 s cooldown + max 3 attempts; orchestrator.py:14129-14146 and spawn_engine.py:4460-4461: same gate), so the watchdog's cap does not bound this loop. Detection is the provider-less generic path: _prompt_block_reason (lead_inbox.py:223-227) calls is_at_feedback_prompt() with no argument → whole-visible-screen scan requiring QUESTION and OPTION regexes (pty_session.py:2805, 2818-2819; regexes at 327-334). TUI dismiss+redraw over ConPTY exceeds 150 ms, so multiple extra '0\r' writes are near-certain; each post-dismiss write submits "0" as a user message, derailing the teammate's turn (wrong action). If the survey text persists in the visible transcript (agy keeps history on screen — the very reason the orchestrator site needed an attempts cap), _reason stays truthy, the ready streak never advances, and at timeout _deliver(unconfirmed=True) re-reads the reason (line 1382), defers up to _PROMPT_BLOCK_DEFER_CEILING_MS=30 s (line 174), then gives up via _warn_lead_delivery_blocked_ceiling (1430-1433): the task is never delivered (stuck). refuted.title: Claude Auth override (base_url/api_key/extra_env) silently ignored: pane reads it from the curated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, Settings saves it to the base profile dir
refuted.scenario: User opens Settings → Claude Auth, sets a base URL + API key (or extra env) for a profile, respawns panes of any real project (project != 'default', TAKKUB_SKILL_GATE unset/1 = default). spawn_engine.py:3342-3343 sets env['CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR'] to the curated dir (pane_env.py:544-545 → user_profile.curated_config_dir_for), then spawn_engine.py:3413 apply_claude_auth_overrides(env) does `config_dir = env.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR")` → load_claude_auth(<curated>/takkub-claude-auth.json) → file absent → blank ClaudeAuthConfig → pane keeps OAuth login; nothing in the UI says why.
refuted.evidence: claude_auth_config.py:177-178 `config_dir = env.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or None` / `env.update(load_claude_auth(config_dir).active_env())`; settings_window.py:3797 saves via `self._users_auth_dir(profile_name)` = the profile's base config_dir; user_profile.py:853-860 ensure_curated_claude_config_dir mirrors only `.credentials.json, settings.json, settings.local.json, keybindings.json, CLAUDE.md` — grep for `takkub-claude-auth|_AUTH_FILENAME` finds no mirror anywhere in src.
refuted.fix: Either add `_AUTH_FILENAME` to the mirror list in ensure_curated_claude_config_dir (user_profile.py:853), or make apply_claude_auth_overrides resolve the BASE profile dir (user_profile.config_dir_for(project)) instead of the pane's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; add a test that spawns with the curated dir active and asserts ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL lands in env.

tracer.reasoning: The cited defect is real but currently MASKED by finding index 5's bug, so the scenario as written is not reachable in default day-to-day use. Verified at v2.1.32: (1) src/agent_takkub/claude_auth_config.py:177-178 resolves the auth file from env CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; (2) src/agent_takkub/settings_window.py:3790-3797 saves takkub-claude-auth.json to the profile's BASE config_dir (_users_auth_dir); (3) src/agent_takkub/user_profile.py:853-860 mirror list omits takkub-claude-auth.json and no other code mirrors it (grep _AUTH_FILENAME|takkub-claude-auth hits only claude_auth_config.py + one error string) — the live curated dir providers/claude/office-agent-takkub confirms no auth file inside. HOWEVER, the spawn order in spawn_engine.py is 3343 inject_curated_claude_config_dir -> 3348-3349 _apply_v2_account_env_override -> 3413 apply_claude_auth_overrides, and the V2 override fires on effectively every claude spawn: v2_router_enabled() falls through to core_v2_settings.flag_enabled which is hardcoded `return True` (core_v2_settings.py:215-225, #515), and core/accounts/facade.py:71-77 legacy fallback always returns an account whose config_dir is set (user_profile.list_profiles():133-137 gives even the default profile one), so core/providers/plan.py:60 rewrites CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR back to the BASE profile dir before the auth read. Proven live in this cockpit-spawned pane: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C:/Users/monch/.claude-work (base dir of the 'office' profile) despite the curated dir existing on disk. So at line 3413 load_claude_auth reads exactly the dir Settings saved to, and the override IS applied under default config on both OSes. The finding becomes live only when (a) an operator sets TAKKUB_V2_ROUTER=0 (documented escape hatch, not default), (b) resolve_account_for fail-opens on an exception, or (c) finding index 5 is fixed by reordering/None-ing the legacy fallback WITHOUT also mirroring _AUTH_FILENAME — its own proposed fixes would activate this bug for every non-default-project claude spawn. Severity as it stands today: med (latent, silent wrong-auth when triggered — pane keeps OAuth instead of the configured proxy — no crash/data loss; but it must be fixed together with finding 5 or that fix ships this regression). Not addressed by the 2026-09-22 batch #702-#710 (quota detector/digest/Codex card/cloudflared only; git log shows claude_auth_config.py and user_profile.py untouched since v2.1.19). Cited line 177 is correct.
tracer.repro: Masked-today proof: in any cockpit-spawned claude pane of a real project run `echo %CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR%` — it shows the profile's base dir (e.g. C:/Users/monch/.claude-work), not DATA_HOME/providers/claude/<profile>-<slug>, so the Settings-saved auth file is found. To trigger the actual bug: (1) start the cockpit with TAKKUB_V2_ROUTER=0 in its environment; (2) Settings -> Claude Auth: pick the pane's profile, set Base URL + API key, Save; (3) open a real project (not 'default', TAKKUB_SKILL_GATE unset) and respawn a claude pane; (4) in that pane `echo %CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR%` now shows the curated providers/claude/<profile>-<slug> dir, which contains no takkub-claude-auth.json, and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are absent from the pane env — the pane silently keeps OAuth login. Same result if finding #5 is fixed by resolving the account before/instead of the curated injector without adding _AUTH_FILENAME to the user_profile.py:853 mirror list.

skeptic.reasoning: Refuted for current code (v2.1.32). The claim ignores spawn_engine.py:3348-3349: _apply_v2_account_env_override runs on every claude spawn (v2_router_enabled() is effectively always on — TAKKUB_V2_ROUTER unset falls to core_v2_settings.flag_enabled which hard-returns True, line 225) and, with no V2 pool, the legacy fallback (core/accounts/legacy_reader.py:29-56) returns a ProviderAccount whose config_dir is the profile's BASE dir (non-empty for registered profiles and for the default entry, user_profile.py:133-137); core/providers/plan.py:51-60 writes it back to env["CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"], overwriting the curated dir set at 3343. Nothing between 3349 and 3413 touches the var, so apply_claude_auth_overrides (claude_auth_config.py:177) reads the BASE profile dir — the exact dir Settings saves to (settings_window.py:3797/_users_auth_dir:3808-3813, same user_profile.list_profiles() config_dir). The auth override is therefore found and applied. Empirical confirmation from finding index 5 of the same batch on this machine: Lead pane env CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C:/Users/monch/.claude-work (base dir), not the curated DATA_HOME/providers/claude/office-agent-takkub. The defect only fires when TAKKUB_V2_ROUTER=0 (explicit operator escape hatch) or both resolver branches throw — not the default path. Caveat: the missing takkub-claude-auth.json mirror in ensure_curated_claude_config_dir (user_profile.py:853-860) is a real latent gap that goes live if finding index 5 is fixed by keeping the curated dir; that fix must also mirror the auth file or resolve the base dir in apply_claude_auth_overrides.
skeptic.repro: Only reproducible outside default config: set TAKKUB_V2_ROUTER=0, save a base_url/api_key for a profile in Settings → Claude Auth, spawn a claude pane in a non-default project with TAKKUB_SKILL_GATE unset — pane env then lacks ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL because the curated dir (no takkub-claude-auth.json) survives to line 3413. With default env (router on), the same steps DO apply the override, refuting the claim.
